cases.sentence: От ___, избранной госпоже и ее детям, которых я люблю как пребывающих в истине.
cases.translation: From the elder, to the chosen lady and her children whom I love because they are living in the truth.
cases.explain: The preposition От (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Благодать, милость и ___ будут с нами в истине и любви от Бога Отца.
cases.translation: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us in truth and love from God the Father.
cases.explain: Мир is the grammatical subject of the compound verb (with благодать and милость), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: И любовь эта заключается в том, чтобы мы соблюдали его ___.
cases.translation: And love consists in this: that we keep his commandment.
cases.explain: Повеление is the direct object of the transitive verb соблюдали (keep), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Много обманщиков вышло в ___, не признающих, что Иисус Христос пришел в человеческом теле.
cases.translation: Many deceivers have gone into the world, who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with the accusative case indicates direction of motion.

cases.sentence: Но тот, кто остается верным его учению, имеет в себе и _____, и сына.
cases.translation: But he who continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
cases.explain: Отца is the direct object of the verb имеет (has), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Если кто-либо приходит к вам и приносит не это учение, того вы не должны принимать в ___ и приветствовать его.
cases.translation: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with the accusative case indicates direction of motion into a place.

cases.sentence: Кто приветствует такого человека, тот становится соучастником в его злых _____.
cases.translation: Anyone who welcomes him shares in his wicked work.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the prepositional case indicates the location or sphere of action.

cases.sentence: Привет тебе от _____ твоей избранной сестры.
cases.translation: The children of your chosen sister send their greetings to you.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Благодать, милость и мир будут с нами в истине и любви от Бога Отца и от Иисуса Христа, Его Сына.
reading.question: What three things does the writer wish upon his recipients?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Благодать, милость и мир' — grace, mercy, and peace.

reading.question: What does this verse exhort believers to do?
reading.explain: The sentence 'Будем любить друг друга' literally means 'Let us love one another.'

reading.ru: Много обманщиков вышло в мир, не признающих, что Иисус Христос пришел в человеческом теле.
reading.question: What is the defining characteristic of the deceivers mentioned?
options: They do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh
reading.correct: They do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh
reading.explain: The text states 'не признающих, что Иисус Христос пришел в человеческом теле' — they do not acknowledge that Jesus Christ came in the flesh.

reading.ru: Кто не живет согласно учению Христа, но идет иным путем, тот не имеет в себе Бога.
reading.question: According to this verse, what does someone who does not follow Christ's teaching lack?
reading.explain: The text says 'тот не имеет в себе Бога' — that person does not have God in himself.

reading.ru: Я надеюсь скоро быть у вас и лично поговорить с вами, чтобы наша радость была полной.
reading.question: What is the writer's hope concerning his visit?
options: To speak with them face to face so their joy may be made full
To rebuke them for their sins
To collect funds for the church
reading.correct: To speak with them face to face so their joy may be made full
reading.explain: The text states 'я надеюсь скоро быть у вас и лично поговорить с вами, чтобы наша радость была полной' — I hope to be with you soon and speak with you face to face, that our joy may be made full.

reading.ru: Привет тебе от детей твоей избранной сестры.
reading.question: Who sends greetings at the end of the letter?
options: The children of your chosen sister
reading.correct: The children of your chosen sister
reading.explain: The final verse states 'Привет тебе от детей твоей избранной сестры' — greetings to you from the children of your chosen sister.
